course_detection_rule: The Base Bank PM identifies Algebra 1 from this Framework; the teacher does not need to name the course in the prompt.
base_bank_pm_role: owns universal build order, canonical item/data/HTML package mechanics, two-view Bank contract, QA boundary, security-form base architecture, and ZIP deliverable
framework_role: owns Algebra-specific philosophy/behavior, original Assessment Plans/exact I-cans, response mode, spiral routing, Practice abundance/count policy, representations, source/reference intelligence, path contracts, graph tool, finalizer, and compatible CSS reference
count_rule: Algebra currently uses the Base 139-per-section inventory with exactly 24 questions in each Practice form; the Framework owns this Algebra-specific resolved count policy and may change it in a future reconciled revision.
practice_rule: Within each 24-question Practice form, 3-5 closely related instances of a high-value family may be desirable. No anti-clone/diversification pass, no second-pass/another-version student labels, and no form-wide generic reasoning/checking suffix.
review_view_rule: Generate unitN_review.html from the same canonical items, grouped by exact I-can then question_family_id. It is internal to the Bank folder and not a dashboard resource.
response_profile: Canonical instructional items and Unit Summatives are constructed/open response; Blooket is the selected-response exception.
